notes:
This release changes MarkSeal's license from MIT to AGPL-3.0-only. The application code and behavior are otherwise unchanged. The version is minor because saved settings, exports, and the review workflow stay compatible.

LICENSE
• MarkSeal source and builds from 2.4.0 onward are licensed under AGPL-3.0-only. The LICENSE file names Richard Wensel as the copyright owner.
• If you modify MarkSeal and let users interact with that modified version over a network, AGPL section 13 requires offering those users the corresponding source.
• Builds from 2.4.0 onward include the AGPL text. The 2.3.0 and earlier releases remain under the MIT license they shipped with.

The Windows installer remains unsigned; Windows may show an unknown-publisher warning. Linux and macOS builds are produced in CI without running the test suite on those platforms.
